🎄【HIGH CAPACITY】：High capacity provides you with a high-quality storage solution, enough to hold a 9FT artificial tree. There is an extra black mesh bag inside the tree bag, colored balls, string lights, stars and other Christmas tree ornaments can also be stored inside.There is also a clear card slot on the outside of the bag to place cards.When you use it next time, open the storage bag and you will have most of the items needed for the holiday effortlessly.
